insights.claim: Dashboard's notebook spawner makes assumptions about shared PVC availability that may not hold when Ceph storage is replaced with an alternative CSI driver.
insights.reasoning: The dependency on notebook-controller is documented, but the storage assumptions are implicit in the spawner flow. If the underlying CSI driver does not support ReadWriteMany access mode, notebook spawning will fail.
unknowns: Which CSI drivers are validated for notebook PVC access
Whether dashboard enforces access mode checks before spawning
counterevidence: The spawner may already validate PVC access modes at runtime
insights.suggested_validation: Review notebook spawner PVC creation for access mode handling.
